task.pr_title: Revert default behavior of --cookies-from-browser and firefox

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
since originAttributes still may contain other values (ref: https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/source/caps/OriginAttributes.cpp#205-240), what about something like:
```suggestion
                cursor.execute(
                    'SELECT host, name, value, path, expiry, isSecure FROM moz_cookies WHERE NOT INSTR(originAttributes,"userContextId=")')
```
